desc: We are please to inform you that Board Meeting of the company held on 8th September,2026 at registered office of the company and in which Board has taken the following decisions .
Register of members and share transfer book shall remain close from 24.09.2026 to 30.09.2026(both days inclusive) for the purpose of AGM of the company to be held on 30th September,2026
Company is providing Remote E Voting facility to the members to cast their vote through remote evoting at 46th AGM to be held on 30th September,2026
Notice of the 46th Annual General Meeting of the company to be held on 30th September,2026.
